ontology_name: SmartCropVision Gen-2 Foliar Pathology Sub-Pixel Segmentation Ontology

classes.description: Non-foliar ambient background (soil, workbench, mulch, air, or non-plant structures)
Healthy photosynthetic foliar canopy tissue with intact chloroplast structures
Pathological chlorotic/necrotic foliar tissue displaying fungal, bacterial, or viral symptoms

metric_definitions.foliar_damage_percentage: Foliar Damage % = (Lesion Pixels / max(1, Leaf Pixels)) * 100.0

severity_thresholds.healthy: Foliar Damage % == 0.0 or non-infected classification consensus

dataset_provenance.zero_pseudo_masks_policy: Pseudo-masks and morphological approximations are strictly prohibited from supervised evaluation
